statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations, lightheadedness, and intermittent syncope suggestive of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and supraventricular tachycardia.
The patient has a history of symptomatic bradycardia and pauses consistent with sick sinus syndrome.
Prolonged cardiac event monitoring (CPT 93271) is indicated to correlate symptoms with arrhythmic events and guide further management.
The service addresses diagnoses I48.0, I47.1, and I49.5.
The claim was denied with reason code CO-97.
The denial is based on the service being bundled into another covered procedure and not separately payable.
